question.text: A sphere is dropped from rest at the summit of a structure measuring h metre tall. If a duration of T second elapses before it hits the ground, find the location of the sphere at time T/3 second.

solution.approach: Express g in terms of h and T, find the distance fallen in the first T/3, and subtract it from h.

steps.text: Write the total height in terms of the total fall time T, using free fall from rest.
Find the distance fallen in time T/3 using this g.
Subtract the fallen distance from h to get the height above the ground.

common_mistakes.text: Correctly finding the distance fallen in T/3 as h/9, but stating that distance itself as the answer instead of subtracting it from h to get the height above the ground.
